biography.text: From Saltcoats in Ayrshire, Clarke played for St Mirren and Chelsea before a coaching career that included Chelsea and West Ham.

Albion appointed the former Liverpool assistant on 8 June 2012. His first season ended in eighth place with 49 Premier League points; the final match was the extraordinary 5–5 draw with Manchester United.
His spell ended on 14 December 2013, after the defeat at Cardiff. Keith Downing took interim charge.
